description: This file defines the ObjectUtils class, which provides static utility methods for handling JsonObject instances, including checking for specific key types, creating JSON objects with boolean entries, serializing booleans, and adding entries to JsonObjects.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for JSON object manipulation, such as checking key types, creating JSON objects with boolean values, serializing booleans, and adding entries.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a key with a boolean value and outputs that value.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject containing a single boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to an existing JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a key with a string value and outputs that value.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value to its JSON string representation.
